title: Conserved Asp233-Asp246 hydrogen bond modulates active site dynamics in class A beta-lactamases.
authors: Lopez-Gallego, Cristina V; Timmer, Monika; Vreede, Jocelyne; Ubbink, Marcellus
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文通过突变和分子动力学模拟研究β-内酰胺酶第二壳层Asp233-Asp246氢键对活性位点构象动态的调控，属于蛋白质结构计算问题，但方法创新性一般。
abstract: Rigid enzymes catalyze chemical reactions by stabilizing the transition state through a specific conformation. Catalytic residues are precisely positioned, and enzyme dynamics are kept to a minimum. It is thought that conserved residues around the active site (second-shell residues) play a crucial role in positioning catalytic residues. Asp233 and Asp246 are two highly conserved second-shell residues in class A beta-lactamases, rigid enzymes that inactivate beta-lactam antibiotics. The two aspartates share a short hydrogen bond, linking beta-strands 3 and 4. The role of this interaction in Mycobacterium tuberculosis beta-lactamase BlaC was studied by mutating the Asp residues to Ala. Disruption of the hydrogen bond subtly affects the activity and stability of the enzyme, suggesting the interaction helps to fine-tune the active site. The effects are larger for BlaC D246A than for D233A, indicating that effects cannot solely be attributed to the loss of the hydrogen bond. Molecular dynamics calculations indicate a shift in the conformational landscape due to the mutations, altering the conformational equilibria of the catalytic residues toward less active states. The results illustrate that second-shell residues act as a complex network that supports the efficient positioning of the catalytic residues.
abstract_zh: 刚性酶通过特定构象稳定过渡态来催化化学反应。催化残基被精确定位，酶动力学保持在最低限度。据认为，活性位点周围的保守残基（第二壳层残基）在定位催化残基中起着关键作用。Asp233和Asp246是A类β-内酰胺酶（刚性酶，可使β-内酰胺类抗生素失活）中两个高度保守的第二壳层残基。这两个天冬氨酸共享一个短氢键，连接β-折叠链3和4。通过将Asp残基突变为Ala，研究了该相互作用在结核分枝杆菌β-内酰胺酶BlaC中的作用。氢键的破坏轻微影响酶的活性和稳定性，表明该相互作用有助于微调活性位点。BlaC D246A突变的影响大于D233A，表明这些影响不能仅归因于氢键的丧失。分子动力学计算表明，突变导致构象景观发生偏移，使催化残基的构象平衡向活性较低的状态转变。结果说明，第二壳层残基作为一个复杂网络发挥作用，支持催化残基的高效定位。
